data.why: Superdry recently opened its first store in Argentina, marking a major international expansion into a new market. New country entries create immediate finance operational friction with local suppliers, setup costs, and varied invoice formats.
data.angle: Opening stores in a new country creates a rush of new local vendors, store setup bills, and foreign-format invoices that overwhelm accounts payable.

not_chosen.reason: Large refinancing news attracts high volumes of generic cold outreach from sales reps, whereas store expansion points directly to operational vendor friction.
An Accounts Payable Assistant posting is too junior and tactical to lead with when reaching out to an Interim CFO.
Hiring a Tax Manager deals with statutory reporting and global VAT governance rather than core accounts payable and invoice processing.
Carrier and locker delivery cost savings is a logistics and checkout achievement rather than a finance workload trigger.
A founder criminal trial and verdict is severe negative news that should never be brought up in sales outreach.

data.subject: first argentina store
data.body:
Hi Greg,

Saw Superdry just opened its first store in Argentina.

Setting up in a new country usually brings a rush of local suppliers, fit-out costs, and invoices in unfamiliar formats. Who is matching and keying those in today?

Mindbody processes over 95% of its invoices end to end with Zamp.

Open to seeing how?

[Your name]
